Some of the people in these videos seem to be doing exactly that.

I was married for 25 years, and my wife had an Extreme Shopping Addiction. I worked harder in an average year than most people living in the developed West will work in their lifetime. Then I did it again the next year.

For "reasons", I was stuck in that situation, with no way out. I'd still be in that situation right now had she not literally passed away. After that, her Adult Children from a previous marriage combined their substantial resources and Sued to steal our business - and I lost everything, including my home. 

Now, exhausted and physically unwell, I am supposed to start over, from scratch, and I am no longer young and strong. I considered just cashing out, because it was so much easier... 

It is ZERO fun living with someone with an uncontrollable Shopping Addiction, and it will legit ruin your life. It's not "Cute". It's not "Funny". It's Real Life, and it will Destroy you. 

Obviously, it will ruin the person with the Addiction - but the people who happen to love that person? Perhaps only the brutality and violence of War would be worse...
